results.title: Babybacks
results.overview: After being rescued by an older migrant-friendly couple, two young lovers from Mexico find themselves living an inescapable nightmare.

results.title: 25 Cats from Qatar
results.overview: The nation of Qatar has a street cat population equal to the entire human population of the entire country – and is growing fast. Disease is rampant, and local adoption is rare. 25 CATS FROM QATAR follows one mission – led by a network of multinational underground animal rescuers in Doha and a Milwaukee flight attendant/ cat cafe owner – to transport out 25 lucky felines and find homes for them abroad, all the while searching for a long-term solution to the crisis.

results.title: Corpus
results.overview: Diane loves coding, but her dream is to become a journalist at the prestigious Nowgazine. When her boyfriend lands the job for himself, war is declared.

results.title: If You Go Towards It for a Long Time
results.overview: The movie is based on Zakhar Prilepin's autobiographical novella "The Forest". The story focuses on the father and son who spend every summer in the village of Isttsy, where they raft down the local Istya River. They have done so for several years, but this time things go astray: a harmless adventure turns into a real disaster. Much later the grown-up son remembers his father through the lens of the past years.

results.title: Ellen and Bengt's House
results.overview: Bengt is equally surprised and moved when Ellen shows up unannounced. Tentatively, they begin to approach each other through shared memories and experiences, while the neighbors’ children run riot outside and the record player blasts DDR punk by Namenlos.

results.title: Wheels & Roses
results.overview: In a whirlwind of magical mishaps and roller-skating mayhem, Sahara, a magic-less teenager, unwittingly finds herself thrust into the fantastical world of roller derby. Teaming up with a squad of quirky, spell-slinging roller derby girls, she embarks on a hilarious journey from zeroes to heroes, determined to conquer the derby scene and prove that even without magic, She’s got what it takes to win it all.

results.title: Controlled Burn
results.overview: Reid spends his final day of parole doing everything that got him there in the first place.

results.title: Love in Paradise
results.overview: When Merel joins her son on a sunny trip to Curaçao ahead of his wedding, she soon discovers the holiday is actually a singles getaway. Amid a group of hopeful romantics, unexpected encounters, and island charm, love begins to surface in ways no one anticipated.

results.title: Nalla Padam
results.overview: Kumaran, a man whose entire life revolves around alcohol, is supported by his mother but constantly opposed by his sister and girlfriend, who want him to change. When alcohol lovers form an association and make Kumaran their leader, his life takes an unexpected turn.  Everything changes when the Central Government announces a nationwide ban on alcohol. Forced to survive without his addiction, Kumaran goes to hilarious and desperate lengths to get a drink. Will Kumaran quit alcohol or find a way to continue? What happens to the Association for Alcohol—and to families across India after prohibition? A mix of humour, romance, emotion, mass moments, social message and revolutionary ideas.

results.title: Chumpa: A Doll Under the Basket
results.original_title: चुम्पा: A Doll Under the Basket
results.overview: Fourteen-year-old Muna wants nothing more than to stay in school, but her dreams are crushed by her village’s rigid tradition of forced early marriage. She turns to her teacher for help, only to be dismissed by the villagers, who ask what use an education could possibly be. In the end, the wedding proceeds, and her dream seems to fade with no way out.

results.title: You'll Never Believe Who's Dead
results.overview: As the Cosgrove family gather for a traditional Irish Christmas, and their financial problems come to the fore, a solution presents itself in the form of a robbery of local reclusive farmer Charlie Bann. But the Cosgrove’s have bitten off more than they can chew, as Charlie Bann is not who he seems to be…

results.title: Holy Destructors
results.overview: It observes an astonishing cosmos of blooming microorganisms, such as fungi and mould, which have been documented with patience and precision. These images are connected to museum paintings depicting historical and modern Easter processions, while the restoration of frescoes and priests' relics raises questions about decay, fragility, and gratitude.

results.title: The Perfect Family
results.overview: The end of lockdown forces a Mexico City family to confront their reality.

results.title: Kamen Rider ZEZTZ: Final Stage
results.original_title: 仮面ライダーゼッツ ファイナルステージ
results.overview: Kamen Rider ZEZTZ: Final Stage is a special online event featuring a character show, cast talk, and live performance as we celebrate the finale of ZEZTZ’s journey.

results.title: The War, Donald Trump and Us
results.original_title: La Guerre, Donald Trump et nous : 2025, l'année de tous les dangers
results.overview: 2025, the year of the intensification of a total and deadly war, which nothing and no one seems able to stop, targeting military personnel and civilians, and which has now claimed more than 1.5 million lives or left that many wounded on both sides. But 2025 is also the year of our break with Donald Trump's America, an America with violent and unpredictable reactions, which risks abandoning the old continent, its most loyal ally for 80 years, for Vladimir Putin. How can we stop this bloodshed on our doorstep? How can we contain the master of the Kremlin, a dictator whose predatory logic threatens to spread beyond Ukraine? Sabotage, ghost ships, interference operations, and drone flights: he is already waging a hybrid war against the rest of Europe. Is armed conflict between Europe and Russia now a possibility?

results.title: Public Access
results.overview: A deep dive into one of America’s most radical media experiments, this documentary uncovers how New York’s underground public access television turned everyday people into boundary-pushing creators. Using rare archival footage, it reveals a chaotic free-speech arena where rules were shattered, censors challenged, and anyone could seize the screen. Long before influencers existed, public access channels like Manhattan Cable Television gave New Yorkers total creative freedom — spawning interactive oddities, anarchic art shows, and pioneering LGBTQ+ programming. As sexually explicit content pushed limits and ignited public outrage, major First Amendment battles ensued. The result is an unfiltered look at a transformative moment in media history that anticipated today’s creator-driven digital world, warning viewers to “brace yourself” for the wildness that defined it.

results.title: Where The Silence Is Heard
results.overview: Gabriela returns to her family home in Chile, left behind after exile. Between her grandparents' tenderness and her mother's emotional distance, she begins to question how love can endure when shaped by fear, absence, and silence.
